title: androsace spinulifera
intro: Androsace spinulifera, commonly known as Spiny Rock Jasmine, is a flowering plant species native to the high-altitude mountainous regions of the Himalayas. It is traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine and has been reported to possess various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Spiny Rock Jasmine are attributed to its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
